description: Unsupported major version and a secret-bearing request are refused before dispatch.

subcases.name: unknown-major
requiredBehavior: Return a bounded structured error if the channel is writable.

subcases.name: secret-bearing-field
requiredBehavior: Reject the disallowed field before dispatch.
Never echo or log the supplied value; redact it from diagnostics and artifacts.
Credentials continue to come only from trusted environment/helper configuration.
